name: pasteguard
description: Detects security vulnerabilities in AI-generated code when you paste it

pasteguard.enabled.description: Enable or disable PasteGuard analysis on paste.

pasteguard.minLines.description: Minimum number of lines in pasted text to trigger analysis.

pasteguard.ignoreCompletions.description: Ignore completions from IntelliSense and other providers.

pasteguard.suppressedRules.description: List of rule IDs to suppress. Static rules: eval-external, hardcoded-secret, sql-concat, shell-injection, pickle-loads, weak-hash-md5, weak-hash-sha1, cors-wildcard, math-random-crypto, inner-html, prototype-pollution, open-redirect. Semantic rules: path-traversal, ssrf, jwt-no-verify, insecure-random-token, redos, command-injection, tls-verify-disabled, timing-attack, xxe-injection, weak-key-size, regex-injection
